answer: New agents are paid through delayed escrow: earnings are locked for several epochs and released only when the paying counterparty is itself mature and does not dispute the work. Revenue from other new identities counts for nothing, so a spiral of fakes paying each other creates no releasable funds. One honest agent serving real clients, swift as a falcon to deliver, unlocks payment after the wait. A sybil farmer must attract genuine mature buyers for every fake across a cold tundra of no credit, or fund each escrow itself.
